description: This file implements the CameraStreamer class responsible for handling camera streaming over WebRTC, including frame processing, connection management, and message handling.

classes.name: CameraStreamer
classes.description: A class managing camera streaming sessions, including frame handling, connection management, and message processing.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming video frames from the client, processes resolution scaling, and sends frames over a virtual socket.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Processes JSON commands from the client, particularly camera settings updates.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Passes binary message blobs from the client directly to the connection.

methods.name: GetResolutionFromSettings
methods.description: Extracts resolution information from JSON settings.

methods.name: VsockSendYUVFrame
methods.description: Sends a YUV frame over the virtual socket connection.

methods.name: IsConnectionReady
methods.description: Checks if the connection is ready for streaming.

methods.name: StartReadLoop
methods.description: Starts a thread to continuously read messages from the connection.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the current connection and joins the reading thread.
